sloka: कर्मणा अनेन केन असि कापथम् प्रतिपादितः ।सुख सुप्तस्य ते राजन् प्रहृतम् केन मूर्धनि ॥३-३१-४५॥
transliteration: karmaṇā anena kena asi kāpatham pratipāditaḥ ।sukha suptasya te rājan prahṛtam kena mūrdhani ॥3-31-45॥

translations.english: By whose action have you been led into this wrong direction? Who has hit you on your forehead while you were sleeping comfortably?
